allowed_sources: conceptgate/ module names, function/class names, docstrings, explicit comments
tests and fixtures encoding expected behavior directly
commit messages copied verbatim with hash
disallowed_sources: general model knowledge about ontology/OWL/GUFO/software architecture
inference from file path or symbol name alone without a supporting text span

evidence_items.text:
E2.2's directed_repair_pc fixture
(dir1_directed) failed 0/10 because the prompt/schema never exposed
structural_composition (or the other FeatureType vocabulary) as an available
repair value.
evidence_items.extraction_note: E2.2.1's design commit message. Attributes the directed-PC fixture's 0/10 failure to the prompt/schema not exposing structural_composition or the rest of the FeatureType vocabulary as an available repair value.

evidence_items.text:
Root-cause analysis of E2.2.1's trial reports found the real
gap was two unstated structural contracts, not vocabulary
evidence_items.extraction_note: E2.2.2's design commit message, one commit later than ev5. States that root-cause analysis of E2.2.1's trial reports found the real gap was two unstated structural contracts, not vocabulary -- addressing the same referent (the directed-PC failure cause) as ev5 and reaching the opposite attribution.
